summary: Full backend + frontend verification of GPX upload feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed (parse with/without ele, malformed, empty -> 400, create summit with has_gpx persists route+profile+status='ok', update remove-GPX clears route). Frontend: verified upload flow end-to-end via Playwright — Log Summit dialog opens, guard toast when lat/lng missing prevents trimmer (verified), after filling lat/lng+name+elev the .gpx upload triggers /api/gpx/parse and GpxTrimmer appears with mini map + slider + 4 live stats (distance=9.74km, gain=1609m, avg=16.5%, max=20.6%). input-distance auto-synced with gpx-stat-distance. Trimming via keyboard ArrowRight on gpx-handle-start changed distance from 9.74km->6.03km and input-distance mirrored (6.03). Manual edit to input-avg-grad (9.9) worked afterward. Save persisted the summit with has_gpx=true, route_len=4, profile_len=4, profile_status='ok'. Map showed leaflet polyline for the GPX summit. Edit mode: gpx-badge, input-gpx-replace, gpx-remove-existing-btn all present; no re-trimmer shown (correct). Remove+Save cleared has_gpx and route=null on server. Regression: preset Mont Ventoux without GPX saved successfully with has_gpx=false, profile_status='ok', profile_len=60 (Open-Elevation still used). All ZZTEST_ data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: AddSummitDialog.jsx: the useEffect at L87-98 unconditionally overwrites distance_km/avg_gradient/max_gradient every time `seg` changes. That is what makes trimming update inputs — good — but it will also *revert* any manual edits the user makes while the trimmer is still mounted if `range` (and thus seg identity) changes again. Behaviour is acceptable per spec (trimming updates the boxes) but users editing distance/avg/max manually will silently lose their edits if they touch the slider afterward. Consider a debounce or explicit 'reset from GPX' button.

Backend /api/gpx/parse silently strips descent by picking top_idx = point nearest summit lat/lng; if a GPX loop passes the summit twice, only the *first* nearest match is picked (min() returns first). Not a bug in current sample but worth documenting.

GpxTrimmer FitBounds refits on every range change (positions dependency includes climbLine coords) — good UX but on very long GPX (>1500 pts capped by GPX_MAX_POINTS) may still cause many re-fits during slider drag. Not observed as a problem here.

server.py L193: profile_status='ok' assumed whenever has_gpx+profile provided by client — no server-side validation of profile array shape. A malicious client could persist any array. Low risk given no-auth app.
index.js ResizeObserver silencer: did NOT observe overlay this run, but prior iteration noted flake — still recommend disabling CRA devServer.client.overlay for defense in depth.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 ZZTEST_ summits (ZZTEST_GPX_Ventoux_UI + ZZTEST_Preset_Ventoux) and 2 more from pytest (ZZTEST_GPX_Ventoux, ZZTEST_GPX_Remove) — all deleted successfully. Two lingering TEST_ summits (TEST_CustomPeak, TEST_north face) from earlier iterations remain in DB but were not created by this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GPX feature works end-to-end. Backend /api/gpx/parse returns points, auto_start_idx, auto_end_idx, has_elevation as spec'd; auto_end_idx for the sample GPX is 5 (summit point) and auto_start_idx>=0 (0 in current impl since first point is lowest ele). Frontend GpxTrimmer renders, live stats + input mirroring work. Edit mode never re-parses raw file — shows badge+Replace+Remove only, correct per spec. Regression: non-GPX preset summit still hits Open-Elevation (profile_len=60). Note: urllib.request against the preview host returns 403 (WAF) — use page.evaluate(fetch) inside browser for API calls from Playwright.
